content:
viv-release: Scheduling 01:20 UTC change window: api@v1.13.0 runtime@2.16.0 router@3.8.0. Console needs X-Canary header plus optional X-Session for sticky.
maya-runtime: Runtime adds lightweight kernel and opt-in batching (off for canary). Prefetch behind flag prefetch_beta.
owen-router: Router handles X-Session for affinity; safe fallback if absent. Console should set both headers for canary tokens.
cli-console: I'll open a hotfix proxy PR to attach headers for canary tokens. Preview will be available.
sam-eng: Recommend pinning for first waves. Rollback triggers: 5xx > 0.4% sustained 5m OR regen p95 > +18% for 5m -> rollback runtime only. Auto-hold if mem > 83%.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by viv-release at 01:20 UTC. Waves: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%. Pin queued. Canary watchers: maya-runtime, owen-router, cli-console.
viv-release: Pin before first wave please: `/deploy pin api@v1.13.0 runtime@2.16.0 router@3.8.0 --note "session-canary 01:20"`
deploy-bot: Pin queued. Confirm with thumbs.
maya-runtime: :thumbsup:
owen-router: :thumbsup:
cli-console: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Wave 1 (10%) started at 01:20:15 UTC. Monitoring hooks: latency, 5xx, session-miss, mem.
maya-runtime: Wave1 baseline looks good. Cold prefetch misses observed. Batching OFF.
owen-router: Headers present, no sticky regressions.
deply-bot: Wave 2 (30%) initiated at 01:28:40 UTC.
maya-runtime: At 30% p95 +10%, 5xx 0.09%, mem 58%.
sam-eng: Hold 8m then proceed.
deploy-bot: Wave 3 (60%) started at 01:37:05 UTC.
maya-runtime: p95 trending +16% but 5xx still low. Synthetic regen probes inserted.
owen-router: Sticky misses ~0.6%, below concern threshold.
sam-eng: If p95 crosses +20% or 5xx >0.4% for 5m we revert runtime.
deploy-bot: No rollback triggered. Wave 4 (100%) started at 01:46:00 UTC.
cli-console: Proxy PR merged to hotfix branch. Preview green.
viv-release: 100% complete. Unpin api/router, keep runtime pinned +20m for observation. `/deploy unpin api router`
deploy-bot: Commands executed. Runtime pinned until 02:06:00 UTC.
sam-eng: Posting release note with prefetch flag and console header details. Good job team. :tada:
